name: io.github.beremaran/jevjam
title: jevjam
description: Typed decisions (choice, score, yes/no) from Laya, Julia-1 and clef-flash on your own GPU

runtimeArguments.name: --gpus
runtimeArguments.description: Give the container the host's NVIDIA GPUs (needs the NVIDIA Container Toolkit)

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the HTTP API and MCP endpoint on loopback

environmentVariables.name: JEVJAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds without inference before the resident checkpoint is freed; 0 keeps it

environmentVariables.name: HF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Hugging Face token for higher download rate limits
